func main func_80041168 vram_clear_blocks 0x80041168 clears 64x128 blocks of the 16x4 VRAM grid (n selects x = (n & 0xF) * 64, y = ((n & 0x10) << 4) + ((n & 0x20) << 2)): 0xFF all, 0xFE the two texture strips x 704-1023 y 0-255 and x 320-639 y 256-511, 0 the strip x 320-959 y 0-255 plus x 320-383 y 256-511, else block n; every call ends with a GPU wait

func main func_80041878 boot_game_data_init 0x80041878 runs calendar_init, player_init, girls_init, event_state_init: the new-game state of calendar, player, girls and events (not the settings); callers game_state_init, soft reset, game_reset_to_title, NAME_ENT (new game, reload)
func main func_800418B0 boot_calendar_init 0x800418B0 start 1995-04-04 (year 95, month 4, day 4, weekday 1 = Tuesday, day_count 0, vacation none); month_calendar[0] = April 1995 (30 days, 1st is a Saturday), [1] = May 1995 (31 days, 1st is a Monday), Sundays kind 1, national holidays kind 2; clears clubs and quarter_flags
func main func_800419FC boot_player_init 0x800419FC clears the 0x7C profile block; health OK and club none (player_flags byte 1 = 0xB0); birthday 1/1 with blood-type field 1; parameters 100/40/40/40/40/32/60/5/0 in PARAM_* order; progress_state place flags set for places 0 2 4 8 9 12 15 (emu: same start state, m-hud), command counters 0, profile snapshot = copy of the profile block
func main func_80041C2C boot_girls_init 0x80041C2C clears the 16 GirlRecords; each: tokimeki 0, affection 0x32, syoushin 0, flags cleared, story_stage 0, club 11 (none); girls 0 and 12 start met; girl 0 also flag bits 3, 6, 7 and girl 12 bit 3; birthdays of girls 0-13 stored (table in spec/m-flow)
func main func_80041F48 boot_event_state_init 0x80041F48 zeroes appointments, clubs, the day_events queue and its index, event_flags (0x100 bytes), appointment places, date_place_history, girl_last_date_spot, date_girl, appointment_flag and the event_log with its count; girl_last_date_spot_timer and girl_event_bits are not touched here
func main func_80042058 boot_settings_defaults_set 0x80042058 current_girl, text_lines_total, text_first_line, text_scroll_state and unk_F63 = 0; voice_mode 2 (cancelable), icon_mode 0, icon_count 0xE, click_mode 0, click_timer 0, double_click_interval 0x20, confirm_button 0 (left), sd_anim_fast 0; run by game_state_init and both resets
func main func_800420D0 boot_start 0x800420D0 entry PC of the executable (wiki/executable.md): stack 0x801FEFF0, heap 0x801FF800 size 0x7F0, bzero 0x45498 bytes from 0x800E60A0, saves gp, calls main_loop; emu: first function of a run
func main func_800422C8 boot_frame_begin 0x800422C8 first call of every loop pass: draw_buffer = the buffer being drawn; points the primitive arena and the second work area at that buffer (the two areas swap places in mode 0x90), initialises its ordering table, clears cursor_moved_this_frame
func main func_800423D4 timer_tick 0x800423D4 callback of the vblank root-counter event: timer_ticks += 1 and system_data.seed += 0x377
func main func_80042400 timer_seed_step 0x80042400 seed += 0x377 and returns it; no caller in src (dead code)
func main func_80042418 sys_init 0x80042418 once at boot: zeroes system_data (0xEE0 bytes), timer_event_start, card_ev_set, pad_driver_init
func main func_80042458 sys_cache_flush 0x80042458 FlushCache inside a critical section; run after an overlay (and after the TT overlay) landed in the slot
func main func_80042488 timer_event_start 0x80042488 opens and enables the event of root counter 3 (counts vertical blanks; target 1, interrupt mode) with callback timer_tick and stores the handle in timer_event; reopened by soft reset and the TT loader
func main func_800424FC timer_event_stop 0x800424FC closes timer_event inside a critical section; soft reset and the TT loader close it before they restart it
func main func_80042A00 pad_update 0x80042A00 once per frame at the end of draw_frame: detect the device, then mouse_to_pad or pad_poll; turbo off on any button but circle, turbo on when the four face buttons of pad 2 are held, pad 2 START flips sd_anim_fast; skipped on a frame where the device changed
func main func_80042AC8 pad_device_detect 0x80042AC8 reads port 1: status byte 0 and id high nibble 1 = mouse (also menu_mode = 0), else pad; 0xFF status = none, kept while a card job is busy; on a change reinits the drivers and returns 1
func main func_80042BD4 mouse_driver_init 0x80042BD4 InitMouse on the two raw buffers, SenseMouse(3, 4), start position (0xA0, 0x78), range 0..0x140 x 0..0xF0
func main func_80042C30 pad_driver_init 0x80042C30 InitPAD on the two 8-byte raw buffers, StartPAD, no auto clear
func main func_80042C74 pad_state_clear 0x80042C74 zeroes cursor_x/cursor_y, mouse_x/mouse_y and the three pad words (held, previous, pressed)
func main func_80042CB0 mouse_to_pad 0x80042CB0 mouse to pointer and pad bits: motion * cursor_speed / 3 added to mouse_x (-0x96..0x8C) and mouse_y (-0x64..0x64) and copied to the cursor actor; left and right button become circle (0x20) and cross (0x40) through confirm_button; double-click mode needs two clicks of one button within double_click_interval + 8 frames; a digital pad in port 2 adds its buttons to the upper half-word
func main func_80043010 pad_raw_read 0x80043010 builds the pad word from the two buffers: (~p2 byte2 << 24) | (~p2 byte3 << 16) | (~p1 byte2 << 8) | ~p1 byte3; its mouse branch (the two mouse buttons as 0x20 and 0x40) is never reached from pad_poll; with no device (0xFF) the function has no return statement (that path is unreachable from pad_poll)
func main func_800430C0 pad_poll 0x800430C0 pad mode: pad_held from pad_raw_read (a half-word of 0xFFFF is dropped), pad_pressed, pad_released, turbo (circle injected every other frame), pause toggle (dead: pause_allowed is never set), soft reset on the frame where pad_reset_frames already holds 0x81 (the 130th frame of SELECT+START+L1+R1; pad 2: to mode 0x11) outside modes 0x20, 0x90, 0xD0, then pad_code_update; emu: reset at frame 140 after a hold from frame 10, mode 0x10 then 0 then title
func main func_80043448 pad_code_update 0x80043448 secret code: pad_held must equal pad_code_table[pad_code_index] exactly; each match advances and sets pad_code_timer to 0x10, which the same call decrements, so the next step has to match within 15 frames or the index resets; 18 matches set pad_code_entered, which stays set for 241 frames counting the frame of the last match (240 more frames); emu: the code at the title menu enters mode 0x11 at stage 1
func main func_80043504 boot_paused_step 0x80043504 empty handler main_loop calls instead of main_state_dispatch while paused
func main func_800789E0 ovl_load_reset 0x800789E0 loader state 0, sectors 0, buffer 0, lba 0 (forgets the resident overlay) and screen mode 0; game_reset_to_title and the soft reset call it
func main func_80078A94 ovl_load_screen_draw 0x80078A94 runs after the loader step every frame: runs the per-frame functions of the HUD pieces that are visible (date panel, message window, parameter panel, mascot, cursor) and, when at least one is visible, draws the screen frame and then, by ovl_load_screen_mode, the backdrop: 0 optional light effect and title slide (TalkWork.unk_74 bits 0 and 1) and the last background, 1 wipe lines over the captured frame, else a cleared screen; the calendar picture is drawn while overlay_target_mode is 0x45
func main func_80078C48 ovl_load_start 0x80078C48 loader state 0: picks the screen mode (modes 0x54 0x55 0x59 0x5A 0x5B 0x5D 0x72 capture the top 160 lines and wipe over them, modes 0x13 0x35 0x50 0x81 use screen mode 0 without a capture), hides sprite quad 0 while sick, maps overlay_target_mode to the disc LBA (24 overlay files; table in spec/m-flow), 0x60 sectors to 0x80132000; same LBA as the resident file skips the read and goes to state 3; emu: read at frame 183 of a title to options run
func main func_80079070 ovl_load_enter 0x80079070 loader state 3: overlay_entry = the entry address of overlay_target_mode (table in spec/m-flow; default 0x80132000), loader state 0, mode = overlay_target_mode with stage, step, substep and both scratch bytes restored (timers cleared)
func main func_80079524 game_mode_is_tt_game 0x80079524 1 when mode is 0xD0 or 0xD1; callers: the sound driver (80079B10)
func main func_80079554 game_mode_is_shooter 0x80079554 1 when mode is 0x90 (TACO); caller: the sound driver
func main func_80079578 game_mode_is_option_2 0x80079578 1 when mode is 0x21; caller: the sound driver (reverb switch of the sound test)
func main func_8007959C game_mode_tt_game_mode_handler 0x8007959C mode 0xD0 handler with its own loader: stage 0 sets system_data.extra_mode_flags bit 0, clears debug_hud_enabled and the VRAM, reads 0x60 sectors from LBA 0x9A6A; 1 waits; 2 checks the file sum (retry from stage 0); 3 calls the TT entry 0x8013E850 (runs its own loop) with the timer event closed; 4 restores timer, sound, CD; 5 mode_tt_game_save_step; 6 returns to saved_mode/stage/step, or to mode 0 when options_dirty is set
func main func_80079800 game_mode_tt_game_save_step 0x80079800 stage 5 of mode_tt_game, substeps: 0 card_start, 1 card_check_poll, 2 file 0 exists? then card_start, 3 card_system_read_poll, 4 system_bank_load, 5 card_start and selected_slot 0, 6 card_system_write_poll (done: sound 0x50F; timeout 0x201 frames or result 0xF0: sound 0x502), then stage_next; any failure jumps to 0xFF
func main func_80061710 title_view_init 0x80061710 libgs projection 1000 and a reference view at (0, 0, 1000) looking at the origin, clip values 0x64 and 0x10000; first of the title 3D setup calls
func main func_80061790 title_lights_init 0x80061790 three directional lights, directions (0,0,100), (0,100,0), (100,0,0), tints (0xFF,0x80,0x80), (0x80,0x80,0xFF), (0x80,0xFF,0x80), ambient 0, light mode 0
func main func_800618B0 title_coordinates_init 0x800618B0 libgs coordinate init for the 16 model_coords records, then flag 0 and z translation 0xFA0
func main func_8006190C title_models_link 0x8006190C HYPOTHESIS: maps the TMD at 0x801F0000, requires object count 13 (else returns 0), links all 16 records to object 0, then record i (0-12) to object (rand() + i) % 13
func main func_80061A3C title_setup_stage 0x80061A3C stage 0, substeps: 0 reset screen and start the sound bank load, 1 start the title BGM and read one model sector (LBA 0xBE13), 2 copy it into the next 12 sectors and read 0xD6 sectors (LBA 0xA0CC) to 0x80180000, 3 palettes (15), 13 photo textures (tpage ids 0x15-0x1A, 0x25-0x27, 0x35-0x38), background blocks, actor 96, 3D setup, srand(timer_ticks), stage_next; emu: stage 1 starts 242 frames after the title
func main func_80061EFC title_intro_backdrop_step 0x80061EFC stage 1 step 0: raises screen_brightness by 1 per frame to 0x80 (and the background layer tint with it); after 601 frames (0x259) step_next; START, cross or circle: white clear colour, models cleared, stage_next (menu)
func main func_80061FC4 title_intro_flash_step 0x80061FC4 stage 1 step 1: screen_flash_gray(step_timer / 2); at 0xFF (510 frames) or a button: hides the backdrop and photos, white clear colour, actor 96 becomes the logo; a button then jumps to the menu stage, else step_next
func main func_8006211C title_intro_logo_step 0x8006211C stage 1 step 2: screen_flash_gray(0xFF - step_timer); stage_next at 255 frames or on START, cross or circle
func main func_8006218C title_intro_stage 0x8006218C stage 1 handler: step_timer += 1, steps 0-2, then title_photos_update every frame
func main func_80062210 title_menu_setup_step 0x80062210 stage 2 step 0: menu 0 with two items (rects x -0x30, w 0xA0, h 0x14 at y 0x42 and 0x52), selection 0, white clear colour, sprite tables cleared, cursor shown, actors 96-98 set up as the menu pictures; step_next
func main func_800623E4 title_menu_cursor_update 0x800623E4 selection (scene_work word 0): pad mode up = item 0, down = item 1 and the cursor actor at y = item * 16 + 0x46; mouse mode hit test of menu 0; any change restarts step_timer (idle timer); item frames swap with the selection
func main func_80062524 title_menu_select_step 0x80062524 stage 2 step 1: cursor update; START or circle hides the cursor, step_next, sound 0x501; step_timer >= 0x259 (601) or SELECT: actors cleared, SND_CMD_STOP_ALL, main_state_set(0x11); emu: idle timeout at 601 frames
func main func_800625C0 title_menu_highlight 0x800625C0 sets bit 0x40 of the byte at +3 of the chosen item's actor (actor 97 + selection)
func main func_800625F4 title_menu_confirm_step 0x800625F4 stage 2 step 2: highlight the chosen item; stage_next after 0x21 frames
func main func_80062634 title_menu_stage 0x80062634 stage 2 handler: step_timer += 1, steps 0-2; step_timer is the idle clock and restarts on every pad up or down press even when the selection stays the same (mouse mode: on every frame the pointer rests on an item)
func main func_800626B0 title_exit_dispatch_step 0x800626B0 stage 3 step 1: full flash level, then selection 0: main_state_set(0x13) (NAME_ENT file and name entry), selection 1: main_state_set(0x20) (OPTION; with debug_hud_enabled pad right gives 0x21 and pad left 0x22), anything else game_reset_to_title; emu: item 0 leaves 162 frames after the press
func main func_80062764 title_exit_fade_step 0x80062764 stage 3 step 0: SND_CMD_FADE_BGM_SLOW every frame, flash level step_timer * 2; at 0x80 frames actors and cursor cleared, sprite tables cleared, step_next
func main func_800627DC title_exit_stage 0x800627DC stage 3 handler: step_timer += 1, steps 0-1
func main func_80062948 title_photos_update 0x80062948 each frame places the 13 photo models: spin from frame_count, translation x = scene_work[i + 1] (start -400 - 100 * i, from title_photo_offsets) that grows by 2 or 3 per frame, y = sin wobble - x / 2, z = -4 * x - 400; emu: screenshot at stage 1 shows photo cards flying past a still background
func main func_80062C28 game_mode_start_mode_handler 0x80062C28 mode 0x10 handler, runs once: movie_play(0, 0xA7, 0x190) (the start movie), flush, CD pause and init, mdec_still_buffers_set(0x80167000, 0x80162000, 0x80162000), display on, VRAM block 0 cleared, back clear on, main_state_set(0); emu: movie starts at frame 622 and mode 0 at 1256
func main func_80053650 bg_still_buffers_set 0x80053650 stores the three MDEC buffers (bitstream, VLC work, output) after resetting the decoder; callers mode_start, dec_bg decode, NAME_ENT
func main func_800536AC bg_still_decode_to_vram 0x800536AC (x, y, w, h): checks the bitstream header (0x3800, version 1), VLC-decodes it and streams 16-pixel-wide slices into VRAM at (x, y); -1 on a bad header, else 1; callers dec_bg, DATE, DATE2, ENDING, ETC, NAME_ENT, TACO
func main func_80053CAC memory_card_step_set 0x80053CAC card_result = 0 and card_step = n
func main func_80053CC0 memory_card_step_next 0x80053CC0 card_result = 0 and card_step += 1
func main func_80053D24 memory_card_event_handle 0x80053D24 polls the card events with software_event_test: done = next step; new card = step n (argument); timeout = retry count + 1 and step 0 (card_busy 0, result 0xFF at 3 retries); error = step 0
func main func_80053DDC memory_card_status_wait 0x80053DDC spins on the BIOS card status until it is not 0, closes the file; status 0x11 or 0x21 counts a retry and restarts at step 0; returns the status (1 = done)
func main func_80053F04 memory_card_check_poll 0x80053F04 card detection, called every frame (card_timer += 1): step 0 info, 1 wait, 2 load, 3 wait, 4 result 1 (OK); a new-card event at step 1 goes to 0x20 (clear, reload at 0x30-0x32) and one at step 3 or 0x31 ends in 0x40 = result 0xF1 (unformatted); returns card_result; emu: the check runs about 76 frames from NAME_ENT
func main func_80054108 memory_card_format 0x80054108 format of the first card slot (bu00:); 1 when it succeeded, 0 else
func main func_80054140 memory_card_scan_poll 0x80054140 result 2 when done: step 0 tests the system file (retry 3, then no system file), steps 1-14 test each save file into system_data.slot_status, then card_result 2
func main func_80054284 memory_card_system_read_poll 0x80054284 steps 0 card_file_read(0), 1 card_status_wait, 2 result 3; result 0xD0 when the read cannot start
func main func_80054388 memory_card_system_write_poll 0x80054388 steps 0 card_file_write(0), 1 card_status_wait, 2 result 0x13; result 0xD0 when the write cannot start
func main func_8005448C memory_card_save_read_poll 0x8005448C steps 0 card_file_read(save_slot), 1 card_status_wait, 2 result 4; result 0xD0 when the read cannot start
func main func_80054590 memory_card_save_write_poll 0x80054590 steps 0 card_file_write(save_slot), 1 card_status_wait, 2 result 0x14; result 0xD0 when the write cannot start
func main func_80054694 memory_card_file_create 0x80054694 builds the name, opens with create and one block, closes; 1 or -1
func main func_80054704 memory_card_file_delete 0x80054704 deletes the file; after a failure it retries while a retry counter stays below 3, and the matched C reads that stack counter before it is set (its start value is undefined); 1 or -1
func main func_8005478C memory_card_file_read 0x8005478C clears card_block, opens the file for reading (async, 16 tries), reads 0x2000 bytes (16 tries); 1 or -1
func main func_80054884 memory_card_file_write 0x80054884 opens the file for writing (creates it on failure), fills the 0x200 header (magic, icon flag 0x13, one block, title, and the palette and three icon frames of the girl in the latest date-like log entry: scene 0, 1, 2 or 0xF, else girl 0), the bank (system_bank_build for file 0, game_bank_build else), copies bank 0 into bank 1, writes 0x2000 bytes (16 tries); 1 or -1
func main func_80054AF4 memory_card_file_exists 0x80054AF4 opens the file once with write access and closes it: 1 when it opens, trying once and then retrying up to 16 more times for the system file (17 opens at most) or 8 more for a save file (9 opens at most); 0 else
func main func_80054BA8 memory_card_system_file_probe 0x80054BA8 slot_info_from_system_data = card_file_exists(0); no caller in src
func main func_80054BE4 memory_card_save_files_probe 0x80054BE4 slot_status[i] = card_file_exists(i) for the 14 save files; returns 14; no caller in src
func main func_80054C4C memory_card_block_clear 0x80054C4C zeroes the 0x2000-byte card_block
func main func_80054C74 memory_card_file_write_sync 0x80054C74 older write: opens file idx, builds the same header with icon 0, writes 0x2000 in one call; no caller in src
func main func_80054E6C memory_card_slot_summary_store 0x80054E6C after a save: stores the current year, month, day, three name buffers, the nine parameter words, girl record 15's 16 counter bytes and the club into the slot_summary arrays of system_data at index selected_slot & 0xF
func main func_80054FC0 memory_card_system_bank_build 0x80054FC0 marks slot_status[selected_slot] = 1, then writes system_data into bank arg of card_block (slot_status, flags, unlock bits, selected_slot, TT and TACO records, album, slot summaries; the layout block only when options_dirty is 0 and a game slot is selected) and stores the byte sum of bytes 4-0xEFF in the first word
func main func_800552DC memory_card_system_bank_load 0x800552DC card_bank_validate, then copies the bank back into system_data (unlock bits OR-ed; TT record only while system_data.extra_mode_flags bit 0 is clear; TACO record only while its saved flag is clear), pushes the layout block into icon_positions, mascot anchor, mascot_choice, length and swing; -1 when no bank is valid
func main func_8005557C memory_card_game_bank_build 0x8005557C writes the whole game state into bank arg of card_block (field list in spec/m-flow), copying the text speed and cursor style into saved_settings first, then stores the byte sum
func main func_80055A38 memory_card_bank_validate 0x80055A38 tries banks 0 and 1: byte sum of bytes 4-0xEFF equal to the first word and at least one non-zero byte; sets album_slot to the first valid bank; 1 or -1
func main func_80055AFC memory_card_game_bank_load 0x80055AFC card_bank_validate, rejects a bank with year 0 or month 0, copies every field back into the game state (text speed and cursor style from saved_settings), recomputes event_log_count, current_girl (girl of the latest log entry with scene 0, 1, 2 or 0xF, 0xFF when none) and date_girl (girl of the latest entry) with event_log_scan; 1 or -1
func main func_80056070 memory_card_file_name_build 0x80056070 name = card_file_prefix + one hex digit for file 0-15 (0 system file, 1-14 saves); 0 for a larger index
func main func_80056284 memory_card_state_reset 0x80056284 card_stop, card_block_clear, slot_status[0-14] cleared, slot_info_from_system_data = 0, card_start; run by NAME_ENT and the command screen before a new card job
data main D_80125120 boot_global_pointer 0x80125120 gp value saved by boot_start (GetGp); never read again
data main D_80125124 boot_previous_stack_pointer 0x80125124 value SetSp returned in boot_start (the previous stack pointer); never read again
data main D_8011ECA8 timer_event 0x8011ECA8 handle of the vblank root-counter event opened by timer_event_start and closed by timer_event_stop
data main D_800E94A0 draw_work_buffers 0x800E94A0 HYPOTHESIS: libgs packet work area: func_800985E0 only stores its argument in one libgs global (the GsSetWorkBase shape); 0xA000 bytes per draw buffer, 0x14000 in all up to prim_arena_buffers; in mode 0x90 the two areas change roles
data main D_800FD4A0 prim_arena_buffers 0x800FD4A0 primitive arena of the game's own drawing, 0x10C00 bytes per draw buffer (the PrimArena size of core); given to SetWorkBase by frame_begin, except in mode 0x90
data main D_800B6D30 ovl_load_screen_mode 0x800B6D30 0 backdrop of the last scene, 1 wipe over a captured frame (modes 0x54 0x55 0x59 0x5A 0x5B 0x5D 0x72), anything else a cleared screen (never set); written by ovl_load_start and ovl_load_reset
data main D_800B3CA0 pad_turbo 0x800B3CA0 1 after the four face buttons of pad 2 were held together: pad_poll then adds a circle press on every odd frame; a press of any other button clears it
data main D_800B3CA4 pad_reset_frames 0x800B3CA4 frames in a row with SELECT+START+L1+R1 held (pad 1, or pad 2 for the opening reset); the reset runs on the frame where it already holds 0x81 (the 130th frame of the hold), any other pad state clears it
data main D_800B3CA8 pad_code_table 0x800B3CA8 18 words: up, release, up, release, down, release, down, release, left, release, right, release, left, release, right, release, cross, circle (0 = nothing held)
data main D_800B3CF8 pad_code_index 0x800B3CF8 next entry of pad_code_table; cleared by title_setup_stage and the NAME_ENT opening movie
data main D_800B3CFC pad_code_entered 0x800B3CFC 1 for 241 frames counting the frame of the last match after the whole code was entered; mode_title tests it from stage 2 on; cleared by title_setup_stage and after the NAME_ENT opening movie
data main D_800B3D00 pad_code_timer 0x800B3D00 u8: 0x10 after each match and counted down per frame (reaching 0 resets pad_code_index); while pad_code_entered is set it counts up from 0x0F (the value after the final match's decrement) and clears the flag when it wraps to 0
data main D_800E8BF0 pad_buffer_1 0x800E8BF0 raw controller buffer of port 1 given to InitPAD and InitMouse: status, id, two button bytes (mouse: two motion bytes after them)
data main D_800E8C30 pad_buffer_2 0x800E8C30 raw controller buffer of port 2 (same layout)
data main D_8011ECAC memory_card_software_event_done 0x8011ECAC handle of the software card event for a finished operation (event spec 0x0004), opened by software_event_start; software_event_test result 1
data main D_8011ECB0 memory_card_software_event_error 0x8011ECB0 handle of the software card event for an error (spec 0x8000); software_event_test result 2
data main D_8011ECB4 memory_card_software_event_timeout 0x8011ECB4 handle of the software card event for a timeout (spec 0x0100); software_event_test result 4
data main D_8011ECB8 memory_card_software_event_new_card 0x8011ECB8 handle of the software card event for a new card (spec 0x2000); software_event_test result 8
data main D_8011ECBC memory_card_hardware_event_done 0x8011ECBC handle of the hardware card event for a finished operation (spec 0x0004), opened by hardware_event_start; hardware_event_test result 0x81
data main D_8011ECC0 memory_card_hardware_event_error 0x8011ECC0 handle of the hardware card event for an error; hardware_event_test result 0x82
data main D_8011ECC4 memory_card_hardware_event_timeout 0x8011ECC4 handle of the hardware card event for a timeout; hardware_event_test result 0x84
data main D_8011ECC8 memory_card_hardware_event_new_card 0x8011ECC8 handle of the hardware card event for a new card; hardware_event_test result 0x88
data main D_800B5A40 title_photo_offsets 0x800B5A40 s16[13]: -400, -500 ... -1600, the start x of the 13 title photos, copied to scene_work[1..13]
data main D_800B3938 memory_card_file_prefix 0x800B3938 string: device name bu00: plus the product code of the original release (BISLPS-00065); card_file_name_build appends one hex digit
data main D_800B4390 memory_card_icon_palettes 0x800B4390 13 palettes of 0x20 bytes (16 colours), one per save icon; copied to the card header at +0x60
data main D_800B58B0 memory_card_icon_images 0x800B58B0 u8 *[13]: three 16x16 4-bit frames (0x180 bytes) per save icon; copied to the card header at +0x80

data main D_8012512B cd_queue_phase 0x8012512B s8: -1 start the command at head, 1 wait for it to finish
data main D_801255B0 cd_audio_position 0x801255B0 sector from cd_position_lba while XA plays
data main D_801255B4 cd_state 0x801255B4 0 busy, 2 done, 4 XA streaming; read by overlays through cd_state_get
data main D_801255B5 cd_read_count 0x801255B5 incremented once per finished read (byte after cd_state)
data main D_801255B8 cd_mode_scratch 0x801255B8 holds mode byte 0x84 passed to CdlSetmode
data main D_801255BC cd_read_end_word_pointer 0x801255BC pointer to the last word of the read destination, tested for the end marker
data main D_801255C0 cd_read_sync_result 0x801255C0 result buffer of CdReadSync in cd_queue_update
data main D_801255C8 cd_sync_result 0x801255C8 result buffer of CdSync in cd_sync_poll
data main D_801255D0 cd_result 0x801255D0 last CdControl result bytes (type WordBytes4)
data main D_801255D8 cd_load_destination_base 0x801255D8 RAM base for the next load group
data main D_800B3D60 cd_read_checked 0x800B3D60 1 after cd_read_sectors, 0 after the unchecked read; selects the end-marker test
data main D_800B3D64 cd_read_retry_count 0x800B3D64 counts failed end-marker tests; when (count & 3) == 3 (3rd, 7th, 11th failure) the drive is reinitialised (command 0xA) and 512 vblanks are waited
data main D_800B3D68 cd_sectors_left 0x800B3D68 last CdReadSync result: sectors left, 0 done, -1 error
data main D_800B3D6C cd_last_read_lba 0x800B3D6C set by ids 6 and 13; never read in src
data main D_800B3648 cd_audio_speaker_offset_table 0x800B3648 16 words indexed by speaker (arg2&15) in xa_clip_request_set
data main D_800B58F0 movie_last_frame 0x800B58F0 frame number of the last decoded movie frame (strNext)
data main D_800B58F4 movie_end_frame 0x800B58F4 end frame argument of movie_play
data main D_800B58F8 movie_offset_x 0x800B58F8 set_movie_offset arg0; added to the VRAM rect x
data main D_800B58FC movie_offset_y 0x800B58FC set_movie_offset arg1; added to the VRAM rect y
data main D_800B5900 movie_flags 0x800B5900 bit 0 = 24-bit mode (480-wide decode); initial value 1, no write found in src
data main D_800B5904 movie_caption_marks 0x800B5904 HYPOTHESIS (name follows movie_captions_update): 22 threshold bytes, scaled by 0x50/0xF and compared with the elapsed frame count
data main D_80125C58 movie_context 0x80125C58 pointer, fixed at 0x80180000 by movie_play (type MovieStreamContext)
data main dec_bg_lba_cache bg_lba_cache 0x800B5920 4 words: [0..1] layer 0, [2..3] layer 1, one per VRAM buffer
data main dec_bg_brightness bg_brightness 0x800B593C 0x80 normal, set_dec_bri, wipe step lowers it
data main D_800B5940 bg_fade_amount 0x800B5940 amount 0..0x80 for bg_fade_draw and bg_crossfade_draw (0x80 = picture at full brightness)
data main D_800B5944 bg_wipe_count 0x800B5944 call counter of bg_wipe_step, reset by bg_capture_screen
data main D_800B594C bg_decode_result 0x800B594C return value of the MDEC decode call
data main D_80122760 view_light_0 0x80122760 first directional light record, white (initLight)
data main D_80122770 view_light_1 0x80122770 second directional light record, green
data main D_80122780 view_light_2 0x80122780 third directional light record, red
data main D_801227A0 view_coordinates 0x801227A0 16 coordinate records of 0x50 bytes (type GraphicsCoordinate2)
data main D_80125C60 view_base_matrix 0x80125C60 copied as the start matrix of rotation and scale in view_models_update_draw

data main D_800E36C8 mouse_position_x 0x800E36C8 per-port cursor x times sensitivity

data main D_800E36EA mouse_sense_y 0x800E36EA u16 multiplier set by SenseMouse
type main StrDecEnv MovieDecodeEnvironment - PsyQ movie decoder's two VLC buffers, image slice buffer and decode rectangles
type main StrCtx MovieStreamContext - movie state at 0x80180000 behind D_80125C58
type main OtRec20 OrderingTableHeader - 20-byte ordering table header, one per frame buffer
type main TaiikuBig GraphicsCoordinate2 - 0x50 bytes with the libgs graphics-coordinate layout (TACO.h says so); not TAIIKU-specific
field main:CdCommand cmd command - libcd command code of the entry: 2 CdlSetloc, 3 CdlPlay, 6 read, 9 CdlPause, 10 CdlInit, 13 CdlSetfilter, 14 CdlSetmode, 21 CdlSeekL, 27 CdlReadS
field main:CdCommand arg lba - sector passed to CdIntToPos for ids 2, 6, 21
field main:CdCommand data param - 16 parameter bytes; read: word = dest address (low 24 bits) + sector count (top byte); byte 15 = 0xFF means no state change at the end
field main:MovieStreamContext pos start_position - CdlLOC of the movie start (file.pos or CdIntToPos)
field main:MovieStreamContext dec decode_environment - MovieDecodeEnvironment block
field main:MovieStreamContext endflag end_flag - set when the stream header frame count reaches the end frame
field main:MouseSample unk_0 x - position / sensitivity x
field main:MouseSample unk_4 y - position / sensitivity y
field main:MouseSample unk_8 buttons - ~raw buttons & 0xC, or -0x100 when no mouse is plugged
field main:GraphicsCoordinate2 unk0 flag - libgs flag word (first word of the graphics-coordinate layout); initCoordinate sets it to 0 after the libgs coordinate init
field main:GraphicsCoordinate2 unk20 translate_z - offset 0x20 = coordinate translation z; initCoordinate stores -0xFA0
field main:ModelRecord flags model_flags - active model flags tested by view_models_update_draw
field main:ModelRecord unk_14 coordinate_flag - same libgs flag word as GraphicsCoordinate2.flag (the graphics-coordinate layout starts at +0x14, its matrix at +0x18); view_models_update_draw clears it after writing a new matrix into the record (HYPOTHESIS: libgs then recomputes the world matrix)
func main file_checksum_ok cd_file_checksum_ok 0x8004636C 8004636C: sums all payload bytes before the four-byte file trailer and compares the stored big-endian checksum; current non-O.BIN name lacked the cd_ module prefix
field main:CdRingState phase command_phase - command pump uses -1 before issuing the head command and 1 while waiting for completion
func main func_80079B10 audio_command_submit 0x80079B10 pushes the low 16 bits of one command word onto the driver queue (tail call to func_8007B5EC); only caller func_80044750 (core: snd_command); O.BIN SD_Call_SD (med, size equal)
func main func_80079C70 audio_bank_transfer_schedule 0x80079C70 takes the lowest slot i with request bit 0x01000000<<i while no running bit 0xF0000000 is set: moves it to running bit 0x10000000<<i, calls snd_vab_transfer(i), clears the running bit (one slot per call); emu: request bits 0x04000000/0x0C000000 then 0x48000000 at frame 1463 after command 0x12; O.BIN SD_HandleVBLVAB (low)
func main func_80079D28 audio_bank_transfer 0x80079D28 SsVabOpenHeadSticky(header RAM, slot, SPU address) then state bit 0x10000<<slot, SsVabTransBody(body RAM, slot) and SsVabTransCompleted wait; on a -1 result reports (slot<<8)|0x01010000 or 0x01020000 via func_80059B04; emu: state word gains 0x40000 then 0xC0000 for slots 2,3; O.BIN SD_TransVAB (low)
func main func_80079E00 audio_bgm_bank_ready 0x80079E00 returns 1 when neither request bit nor running bit of the BGM slot (bgm_slot) is set; the argument is never read (asm stores a0 and ignores it), so the callers passing slots 0..3 all test the BGM slot; O.BIN SD_ISVabAvailable (med)
func main func_80079E4C audio_xa_frame_update 0x80079E4C per frame: state 0x400 (voice playing) -> snd_xa_check_end; request 0x200 (start issued) -> snd_xa_start_poll; O.BIN SD_XATask (med)
func main func_80079E9C audio_xa_check_end 0x80079E9C at or past xa_clip_end (xa_position_get() >= it): snd_xa_fade_start(0xB4) unless a voice fade already runs (otherwise nothing happens); before the end: SD_GetCDLevel(&D_80125E60) refreshes the level meter; O.BIN SD_CheckXASector (med)
func main func_80079F00 audio_xa_start_poll 0x80079F00 once cd_state_get() has bit 4 (XA playing): clear request 0x200; a queued next clip -> stop, promote, start it; else if not paused set state 0x400, clear 0x100000, xa_volume = xa_volume_full, SsSetMVol(0x7F,0x7F), SsSetSerialVol(0,xa_volume), serial mix on; O.BIN SD_IsXAReady (low)
func main func_8007A008 audio_pending_update 0x8007A008 if request_flags != 0: top byte -> snd_vab_transfer_schedule, low byte -> snd_bgm_update, second byte -> snd_xa_fade_update; O.BIN SD_HandleVBL (low)
func main func_8007A080 audio_control_dispatch 0x8007A080 class 0 commands by id & 0xF0: 0x10 bank transfer, 0x20 bank assignment, 0x70 stop (bit 1 BGM, 2 voices, 4 voice clip), 0xB0/0xC0/0xD0 fade (bit 1 BGM, 4 voice clip), 0xE0 pause, 0xF0 resume (the voice-clip bits 0x74/0xE4/0xF4 call snd_xa_control and then snd_xa_promote_next), anything else snd_cmd_system; emu: 0x7F, 0x12, 0x23/0x24/0x2E, 0x6, 0x71 seen; O.BIN SD_BranchCTRL (med)
func main func_8007A254 audio_command_bank_transfer 0x8007A254 ids 0x11 (slots 0,1), 0x12 (slots 2,3), 0x13-0x16 (one slot): snd_vab_body_addr_set, then per slot snd_vab_dispose + snd_vab_request_transfer; emu: command 0x12 at frame 1462 sets request bits 0x04000000 then 0x0C000000; O.BIN SD_VABTransfer (med)
func main func_8007A354 audio_command_bank_assign 0x8007A354 ids 0x21/0x24 set se_slot_a,se_slot_b = 0,3 / 3,0; 0x22/0x23 set bgm_slot,bgm_auxiliary_slot = 1,2 / 2,1; 0x2F/0x2E pick sequence pack set 0/1 (RAM 0x8001C000 / 0x8002E800) and index it; emu dump after 0x23,0x24,0x2E: slots 2,1,3,0 and set 1; O.BIN SD_BufferUpdate (med)
func main func_8007A43C audio_command_system 0x8007A43C ids 1 mono, 2 stereo (snd_output_mode_set), 3 snd_xa_forget, 4 snd_voices_kill, 5 set state 0x100000 (next fade goes through master volume), 6 snd_xa_reset; emu: 6 is sent by func_800462C8 before every CD data read; O.BIN SD_HandleSys (low)
func main func_8007A4DC audio_xa_fade_update 0x8007A4DC runs snd_xa_fade_tick while request bit 0x100 (voice fade) is set; O.BIN SD_HandleVBLXA (med)
func main func_8007A50C audio_xa_fade_tick 0x8007A50C while state has 0x400 or 0x4000: xa_fade_accumulator += xa_fade_rate, on carry past 0xFF xa_volume -= xa_fade_step; <= 0 calls snd_xa_fade_finish, else SsSetSerialVol(0,xa_volume,xa_volume); O.BIN SD_HandleXAFadeOut (med)
func main func_8007A5BC audio_xa_fade_finish 0x8007A5BC snd_xa_control(0x74) stop; then, when the paused bit is clear (always the case here, the stop just cleared it), promote the queued clip and start it when xa_clip_start != 0; O.BIN SD_FinishFadeOutXA (med)
func main func_8007A618 audio_speaker_volume_set 0x8007A618 HYPOTHESIS: the speaker index is the heroine index (h-cdio: 25 of 104 xa_clip_request_set calls pass the current girl) so this is a per-voice loudness correction; fact: xa_volume_full = 100, except speaker 6 -> 125, 7/9/11 -> 95, 10 -> 90, 12/13 -> 110, 15 -> 105; emu: speaker 15 gave 0x69 in the prologue; no O.BIN row
func main func_8007A6AC audio_command_xa 0x8007A6AC class 3: 0x300 starts a voice clip from the 4-word request of xa_clip_request_get (speaker, base sector, start word, end word), 0x1300 stop (then snd_xa_promote_next), 0x2300 pause and 0x4300 resume (snd_xa_control only, no promote; no sender); start/end sectors = index*(0x20, or 8 for speaker 15)+channel+base -/+ 0x10; queues behind a playing clip with a fast fade; emu: 0x300 at frame 3836; O.BIN SD_XACall (low)
func main func_8007A868 audio_xa_promote_next 0x8007A868 queued clip becomes the current one: xa_clip_end = xa_next_end, xa_resume_position = xa_clip_start = xa_next_start, filter bytes shift down (xa_params[4,6] = [5,7]), next fields and bytes 5,7 cleared, level meter outputs cleared, state 0x400/0x4000 and request 0x200/0x100 cleared (so it also cancels a running voice fade and the paused mark, and issues no CD stop); the class-0 commands 0x74, 0xE4 and 0xF4 call it right after snd_xa_control; O.BIN SD_XAParamUpdate (med)
func main func_8007A924 audio_xa_play 0x8007A924 snd_cd_audio_init (mute, CD mode 0xC8), xa_params[0,1] = file,channel from bytes [6],[4], request 0x200, cd_command(0xD, start sector, xa_params); emu: break shows a0 = clip start 0x16E5C and the dumped state; O.BIN SD_PlayXA (med)
func main func_8007A98C audio_xa_control 0x8007A98C selector 0x74 stop (mix off, cd_command 9, clear 0x400/0x4000/0x200/0x100); 0xE4 pause (start pending: state 0x4000 and cd_command 9; playing: remember position, state 0x400 -> 0x4000, snd_xa_fade_start(0xB4)); 0xF4 resume (only when 0x4000 is set: replay from xa_resume_position or finish the chain). The game sends 0xE4/0xF4 only as class-0 commands, where snd_control_dispatch calls snd_xa_promote_next right after, which undoes 0x4000 and the fade request, so pause does not fade or stop a playing clip and 0xF4 never acts (spec 8.4); the class-3 forms 0x2300/0x4300 skip the promote but nothing sends them; O.BIN SD_StopXA (low)
func main func_8007AB24 audio_xa_fade_start 0x8007AB24 if no voice fade runs: xa_fade_accumulator = 0 and request bit 0x100; rate/step are always (re)written: (0x100,10) for 0xB4 and any other id, (0x100,1) for 0xC4, (0x80,1) for 0xD4, so a later command changes a running fade (unlike the BGM fade); O.BIN SD_FadeXA (low)
func main func_8007ABE0 audio_bgm_update 0x8007ABE0 per frame: request bit 2 and snd_bgm_bank_ready -> snd_bgm_start; while BGM plays with request bit 1 (fade): bgm_fade_accumulator += rate, on carry bgm_volume -= step; < 0 -> snd_bgm_fade_finish, else SsSeqSetVol (or SsSetMVol scaled by bgm_volume*0x7F/bgm_volume_full when state 0x100000 and no voice clip); O.BIN SD_HandleVBLSEQ (low)
func main func_8007AD6C audio_bgm_fade_finish 0x8007AD6C fade end: with state 0x100000 and no voice clip SsUtAllKeyOff and master volume 0; snd_bgm_control(0x71); starts bgm_sequence_id (promoted from bgm_next_sequence_id) when it is not -1; O.BIN SD_FinishFadeOutSEQ (low)
func main func_8007ADD8 audio_command_bgm 0x8007ADD8 class 2: 0x2NN play sequence NN (request bit 1 -> finish the fade now and chain; BGM playing -> store NN in bgm_next_sequence_id and fast fade 0xB1; else start now), 0x12NN stop, 0x22NN pause, 0x42NN resume; emu: 0x200 after 0x23,0x24,0x2E; O.BIN SD_SEQCall (med)
func main func_8007AEC0 audio_bgm_request_start 0x8007AEC0 bgm_sequence_id selected: start at once when the BGM slot has no transfer pending, else request bit 2 (snd_bgm_update waits); O.BIN SD_PlaySeq (med)
func main func_8007AF0C audio_bgm_start 0x8007AF0C except in TT and TACO modes and when bgm_slot is 2: snd_voices_kill; reverb depth from snd_seq_reverb_depth[set][seq] (0 in sound-test mode 0x21 when state 0x10000000); SsSeqOpen(address,bgm_slot) (-1 -> error 0x0104xxxx, snd_bgm_fade_finish); state 0x100, bgm_volume = VAB master volume - 0x19 (-0x18 more in mono), SsSeqSetVol, SsSeqPlay(seq,1,1); emu: state 0x00040110 at frame 1464; O.BIN SD_SeqGo (low)
func main func_8007B144 audio_bgm_control 0x8007B144 selector 0x71 stop (volume 0, SsSeqStop, SsSeqClose, bgm_sequence_id = bgm_next_sequence_id, next = -1, state 0x100/0x1000 and request 1 cleared), 0xE1 pause (SsSeqPause, state 0x1000), 0xF1 resume (SsSeqReplay, state 0x100); O.BIN SD_StopSeq (low)
func main func_8007B2B4 audio_bgm_fade_start 0x8007B2B4 whole body only if no BGM fade runs (a running fade ignores new fade ids): bgm_fade_accumulator = 0, request bit 1; (rate,step) = (0x100,10) 0xB1, (0xC0,1) 0xC1, (0x80,1) 0xD1; emu: 0xD1 re-sent every frame 4854-4911 without restarting; O.BIN SD_FadeSeq (low)
func main func_8007B358 audio_command_se_a 0x8007B358 class 5: key = (se_slot_a<<8)|((id&0xFF)>>4) program, note word ((id&0xF)*4+0x18)<<8; id bit 0x1000 stops (snd_se_stop) else snd_se_play; O.BIN SD_SECall (med)
func main func_8007B3DC audio_command_se_b 0x8007B3DC class 6: same as snd_cmd_se_a with se_slot_b as the bank; O.BIN SD_OtherSECall (med)
func main func_8007B460 audio_command_se_bgm_bank 0x8007B460 class 7: same as snd_cmd_se_a with bgm_slot (the bank of the running BGM) as the bank; O.BIN SD_SECallInSEQ (med)
func main func_8007B4E4 audio_command_se_bgm_auxiliary 0x8007B4E4 class 8: same as snd_cmd_se_a with bgm_auxiliary_slot as the bank; O.BIN SD_OtherSECallInSEQ (med)
func main func_8007B568 audio_se_play 0x8007B568 releases the same (bank, program, note) then clears state 0x100000, SsSetMVol(0x7F,0x7F) and keys it on at se_volume both channels (SpuVmSeKeyOn in the asm); O.BIN SD_PlaySE (low)
func main func_8007B5CC audio_se_stop 0x8007B5CC key off of the (bank, program, note) in its arguments (SpuVmSeKeyOff in the asm); O.BIN SD_StopSE (low)
func main func_8007B5EC audio_queue_push 0x8007B5EC appends a u16 to the 32-entry queue at D_80125CC2 and returns 0; returns -1 and drops the command when the count is already 0x20; O.BIN SD_AddEvt (med)
func main func_8007B640 audio_queue_clear 0x8007B640 count = 0; called at the end of snd_command_pump and in snd_init; O.BIN SD_FlashEvent (med)
func main func_8007B64C audio_queue_pop 0x8007B64C returns the oldest queued command (0 when empty, so command 0 cannot be queued usefully) and shifts the rest down; O.BIN SD_GetNextEvent (med)
func main func_8007B6E0 audio_xa_forget 0x8007B6E0 command 3: snd_xa_control(0x74) stop, then clears xa_clip_start/end, next, resume position and filter bytes 4,5; no O.BIN row; callers NAME_ENT, func_80075320, func_8005A0B0
func main func_8007B734 audio_xa_reset 0x8007B734 command 6: serial mix off, clears state 0x400/0x4000 and request 0x200/0x100, all XA bookkeeping words, the level meter outputs and bytes 4,5; emu: sent before every CD data read; O.BIN SD_KillXA (low)
func main func_8007B7E0 audio_voices_kill 0x8007B7E0 unless TT mode with BGM playing: SpuVmFlush guard, SsUtAllKeyOff(0), reverb off, reverb mode 3, reverb on (silences every sound-effect voice); command 4 and 0x72/0x73/0x7F bit 2; O.BIN SD_KillSPU (low)

data main D_80125E60 audio_cd_level 0x80125E60 CdLevelMeter work area (left output at +0); fields below; read by getCDlevel and SD_GetCDLevel (src/main/8007C030.c)
data main D_80125E70 audio_sequence_table 0x80125E70 byte buffer given to SsSetTableSize(table,1,1) as the libsnd sequence table
type main CdLevelWork CdLevelMeter - request/output block of SD_GetCDLevel at D_80125E60 (5 halfwords used); 8007C030.c (m-dates-b) shares it, reconcile there
field main:CdLevelMeter unk_00 left - left output level after scaling; 0..255 with precision 8
field main:CdLevelMeter unk_02 right - right output level
field main:CdLevelMeter unk_04 precision_bits - result is shifted right by 16 - this value (8 -> 0..255)
field main:CdLevelMeter unk_06 sample_count - samples read per channel from the SPU capture buffer (0x20)
field main:CdLevelMeter unk_08 options - low nibble method 1 peak / 2 average, 0xF0 == 0x20 squares, 0xF00 shaping 0x100/0x400/0x800
field main:AudioState unk_00 state_flags - what is going on: bits in SndStateFlags (stereo 0x10, mono 0x20, BGM playing 0x100, voice clip playing 0x400, BGM paused 0x1000, clip paused 0x4000, VAB slot open 0x10000<<i, master-volume fade 0x100000, sound-test reverb off 0x10000000); emu: 0x00040110 while BGM plays with slot 2 open
field main:AudioState unk_04 request_flags - pending work: SndRequestFlags (BGM fade 1, BGM start waits for bank 2, voice fade 0x100, voice start issued 0x200, VAB transfer wanted 0x01000000<<i, running 0x10000000<<i); also reached as D_80125D14
field main:AudioState unk_08 xa_clip_start - start sector of the current/last voice clip, 0 = none; snd_xa_play starts here
field main:AudioState unk_0C xa_clip_end - end sector of the current clip; snd_xa_check_end fades when xa_position_get() >= it
field main:AudioState unk_10 xa_next_start - start sector of a clip queued behind the current one, 0 = none
field main:AudioState unk_14 xa_next_end - end sector of the queued clip
field main:AudioState unk_18 xa_resume_position - sector kept for a resume: set by the pause selector while a clip plays (not before the clip start), then overwritten by snd_xa_promote_next with the new clip start (the class-0 pause promotes at once, so it is never replayed)
field main:AudioState unk_1C xa_volume - current CD-audio volume (SsSetSerialVol both channels), lowered by fades
field main:AudioState unk_1E xa_volume_full - volume at clip start, set per speaker by snd_speaker_volume_set (100 default); emu: 0x69 for speaker 15
field main:AudioState unk_20 bgm_volume - current sequence volume (lowered by fades)
field main:AudioState unk_22 bgm_volume_full - volume at BGM start = VAB master volume - 0x19, minus 0x18 in mono; emu: 0x66 with master volume 0x7F
field main:AudioState unk_24 se_volume - volume used for both channels of every sound-effect key on (0x5A, 0x42 in mono)
field main:AudioState unk_26 se_volume_default - copy of se_volume set by snd_output_mode_set (0x5A - attenuation)
field main:AudioState unk_28 bgm_sequence_handle - libsnd sequence access number from SsSeqOpen (also D_80125D38)
field main:AudioState unk_2A bgm_sequence_id - sequence number of the BGM to start or running, -1 none (also D_80125D3A)
field main:AudioState unk_2C bgm_next_sequence_id - sequence number waiting behind the BGM fade, -1 none; cleared by snd_bgm_next_clear
field main:AudioState unk_2E bgm_fade_accumulator - BGM fade accumulator, 8.8 fixed point; a carry past 0xFF steps the volume
field main:AudioState unk_30 bgm_fade_step - volume units taken off per carry (10 fast, 1 medium/slow); init 0x80
field main:AudioState unk_32 bgm_fade_rate - accumulator added per frame (0x100 every frame, 0xC0, 0x80); init 0xFF
field main:AudioState unk_34 xa_fade_accumulator - voice-clip fade accumulator, 8.8
field main:AudioState unk_36 xa_fade_step - volume units per carry for the voice fade
field main:AudioState unk_38 xa_fade_rate - accumulator added per frame for the voice fade
field main:AudioState unk_3A sequence_pack_set - which sequence pack is current: 0 (RAM 0x8001C000) or 1 (0x8002E800); set by ids 0x2F/0x2E; emu: 1 after 0x2E
field main:AudioState unk_3C bgm_slot - VAB slot used by the BGM sequence and by class 7 effects; 1 or 2 (ids 0x22/0x23); emu: 2 after 0x23
field main:AudioState unk_3E bgm_auxiliary_slot - VAB slot used by class 8 effects (2 or 1)
field main:AudioState unk_40 se_slot_a - HYPOTHESIS: this slot holds the shared system-sound bank (h-graphics: files b,c are shared banks and slot 0 is the small one); fact: VAB slot for class 5 effects, 0 or 3 (ids 0x21/0x24)
field main:AudioState unk_42 se_slot_b - VAB slot for class 6 effects (3 or 0)
field main:AudioState unk_44 cd_mode_param - parameter bytes for cd_command(0xE, 0, ..): byte 0 = 0xC8 (double speed, real time, XA filter)
field main:AudioState unk_48 xa_params - XA bookkeeping bytes: [0] filter file, [1] filter channel (passed to cd_command 0xD); [4] channel and [6] file of the current clip, [5],[7] of the queued clip; emu: [4]=6, [6]=0x11 at the prologue clip
func main func_8007C784 scene_wait_cd_read 0x8007C784 step: wait for the CD sync bit; on the 0x402nd call reset the CD ring/background cache and retry. DATE/GEKO/SHOUGATU tables; body in scene_library.c

func BUNKAKEN func_80145844 tour_window_title_set 0x80145844 sets the message window title for the exhibit in culture_exhibit_club and the year (11 titles, year 95/96/97 where they differ); used by every stage after the background loads

func BUNKAKEN func_80145A64 tour_event_log_add 0x80145A64 inline event_log_add of a visit, called by the finish step when the companion is not 0xFF and its mood rank is below 4: record (girl, flag 4*club+3 when she is at her own club else 4*club+4, scene 0x14, closeness from get_g_zyotai_h, date); skipped for the refused girl; companion 0xB logs girl 0 but the rank tests read the raw id 0xB (girl 11)
func BUNKAKEN func_80145E40 tour_stage_run 0x80145E40 copies the 142-entry stage table to the stack and calls entry [GameState.stage]
func BUNKAKEN func_8013BD84 tour_invitation_pick_girl 0x8013BD84 picks who invites the player. Girl 0 (no met test): her weighted affection must be >= 80 (the code tests get_h_yuukou(0) twice, against 50 then 80; her weighted tokimeki is not tested here) and then her raw affection + tokimeki seeds the running maximum, else the maximum is 0. Girls 1-10: met, weighted tokimeki >= 50 and weighted affection >= 80; the raw sum must be strictly greater than the maximum to replace the winner (ties keep the lower id). Year 96 forces the sum of girls with club 1 or 4 to 0 (girl 0 seeds 0). The winner (girl 0 when nobody replaced her) is then checked again against tokimeki >= 50 and affection >= 80, so a girl 0 with affection >= 80 and tokimeki < 50 seeds the maximum, cannot win, and blocks every girl whose sum is not larger: nobody invites; girl 0 in year 96 with club 1 or 4 never wins; girl 0 with a club id of 6 or more becomes id 11; stores culture_visitor_girl and returns 1, else 0
func BUNKAKEN func_8013BFA0 tour_script_tables_apply 0x8013BFA0 copies the three table pointers written by a script setter into the dialogue text, command and voice table words
func BUNKAKEN func_80144D38 tour_club_menu_init 0x80144D38 builds the club menu: six items in two columns (x -0x80 and -0x08, y 0x32 + 0x10 per row, 0x78 x 0x10), registers them with menu_set and starts the cursor
func BUNKAKEN func_80144E9C tour_club_menu_update 0x80144E9C per-frame menu check and cursor; on circle (pad_pressed & 0x20) the hovered item index goes to dialogue_choice and the menu closes

func BUNKAKEN func_80149144 tour_phase_shiori_birthday 0x80149144 phase 9: the festival day is Shiori birthday and the companion is 0 or id 11; three paths: club id below 6 (step 0x2E, her club exhibit, two-way question then a three-way choice), the player birthday too and rank below 2 (step 0x16, P_BIRTH park scene), else the park (rank below 2) or corridor scene; gains by original option 0/1/2: tokimeki +3/+2/+0, affection +2/+1/+1, syoushin -15/-10/+10; declining at the club costs 1 affection and gives 5 syoushin; sets daily_event_bits mask 1; 73 steps
func BUNKAKEN func_8014A0E0 tour_phase_player_birthday 0x8014A0E0 phase 10: the festival day is the player birthday and the companion is girl 4-10 with mood rank below 2: park scene with P_BIRTH section chosen by her id (4->10, 5->7, 6->8, 7->5, 8->0, 9->9, 10->12), logs flag 0x19, no point change; sets daily_event_bits mask 4; 12 steps

local BUNKAKEN:tour_apply_points b points_1996 - local copy of the 1996 [girl][club] gain-code table.
